newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf RFG heats up late day on Bayway outage.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf RFG heats up late day on Bayway outage.

text.p: Spot reformulated gasoline prices rallied in Houston late Thursday amid talk that some Gulf players tried to exploit what they hoped would be an extended outage at Tosco's Bayway refinery, traders said.
Spot prices shot up on news of a fire at the 140,000 barrel per day fluid catalytic cracker at the New Jersey refinery, tracking the soaring NYMEX markets.

But with the exception of the U.S. Gulf (USG) reformulated gasoline, differentials ended the day little changed. Traders said activity was fairly subdued, with many players out following an industry gathering Wednesday evening.

Prompt reformulated unleaded 87-octane A4 barrels changed hands at about 2.10 cents under the screen. Market players said the sale was designed to catch any jump in prices at the other end of the Colonial Pipeline in the event of a prolonged Bayway cat cracker problem.
"It was a roll of the dice I'm sure," one Houston trader said.

New York Harbor diffs surged higher early in the day on the news of the Tosco fire as sellers pulled back from the market, though that strength was short-lived, with gasoline diffs ending only slightly up on the day.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
